items.title: Only ONE Isn't 10p! 🪙 Riddle #16 Answer + Riddle #17: Socks in the Dark 🧦 #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, person 1 had 2 coins worth 30 pence in total and one of them is not a 10 pence coin.  The trick? It only said one of them is not 10 pence. That one is the 20 pence.  And the other coin is the 10 pence. 20 plus 10 makes 30 pence.  Now, a brand new mystery.  Power cut. Person 1 has to get ready in total darkness.  In the drawer, 10 black socks and 10 white socks all mixed up.  Person 1 cannot see a thing and needs just one matching pair.  So, how many socks must Person 1 take out to be sure of a pair?  Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.

qa.heard: کیا اللہ آپ کی شکل اور دولت کو دیکھتا ہے؟ جو آپ سن کر دل ہیل جائے گا؟  حضرت ابو حوریرا رزی اللہانو دے روایت ہے کہ  ہمارے نبی محمد مصطفہ صل اللہ وتعال علیہ وعایلی ہی وسلم نے فرمایا  بیشک اللہ تمہاری صورتوں اور تمہارے مالوں کو نہیں دیکھتا  بلکہ وہ تمہارے دلوں کو اور تمہارے عمال کو دیکھتا ہے  مہنگے کپڑے نہیں بڑی گاری نہیں صاف دل اور اچھے عمال  آج ایک اچھا کوم خاموشی سے کریں جو صرف اللہ دیکھے  کمنٹ میں لکھیں یا اللہ ہمارے دل صاف کردے  یہ بیڈیو آگے بھیجے یہ بھی ایک اور صدقہ ہے

items.title: Grandpa Has No Umbrella! ☂️ Be Kind to People | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.salutation: Sahil's recorded clip spliced via <SAW> (fixed audio; whisper cannot confirm 'Wa Aalihi')
qa.heard: Oh no! It's raining and grandpa has no umbrella. What should we do?  Listen, our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa,  sallallahu alaihi wa alaihi wa sallam, once said,  Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to people.  Let's be kind, share your umbrella and keep grandpa dry.  Help carry the heavy bags. One, two, up we go.  Little brother is crying, give him a big hug and share your toy.  When we are kind to people, Allah is kind to us.  Who will you be kind to today? Tell your grown up.
